evals.name: no-ticket-work-on-main
evals.prompt: I just fixed a bug in the parser that was crashing on empty input — found it while testing. The change is right here in this repo but I never opened an issue for it. Can you get this tracked properly and pushed?
evals.expected_output: Drafts a GitHub issue (problem + proposed solution) from the diff, gets approval, creates it via gh, moves work off main onto a new branch named <slug>-<issue#>, commits with a message referencing the issue (Fixes #N), and pushes with upstream set.
assertions: Created a new issue via `gh issue create` (no pre-existing ticket was found)
Moved the work off `main` onto a new branch whose name ends in the issue number
Created a commit that references the issue (Fixes #N)
Pushed the new branch to origin with upstream set
Did not leave the fix as uncommitted changes on main

evals.name: ticket-in-branch-name-no-pr
evals.prompt: This branch has some fix work on it for the config loader. Can you make sure it's tracked and push it up?
evals.expected_output: Detects the issue number in the branch name, confirms via gh that the issue exists and has no attached PR, reports the existing issue URL, then commits the work with a Fixes #N reference and pushes. Does NOT create a duplicate issue.
assertions: Detected the existing issue number from the branch name and looked it up
Did NOT create a duplicate issue
Checked whether a PR is attached to the issue
Committed the work with a reference to the issue number and pushed
Left the branch name ending in the issue number

evals.name: ticket-found-pr-attached-stop
evals.prompt: I've got a fix on this branch. Please track it and get it pushed.
evals.expected_output: Detects the issue number, finds the issue exists AND already has a PR attached, reports the issue plus the PR's branch name (headRefName), and STOPS — no new branch, no commit, no push, no duplicate issue.
assertions: Detected the existing issue number and looked it up
Checked for an attached PR and found one
Reported the attached PR's branch name to the user
STOPPED: no new commit, no push, no duplicate issue
Left the uncommitted fix untouched in the working tree
